rationale.faithfulness: HH359 fails by its kill rule with a powered test (0.95 at J 0.3); the informative finding (coupling vanishes for all pairs in the merged room, returns after the split) is supported by two estimators but was not pre-registered as such. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F2 G0 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: Concrete operator rule: merging rooms dilutes per-pair coupling to zero for a week; read path necessary, not sufficient.

one_line: The NE42 room merge did not switch on talk coupling between the two groups; per-pair coupling vanished for all pairs in the merged room and returned within the old rooms after the split.

models.note: J does not follow the merged-week adjacency; dilution instead

v2.claim: Merging the rooms (NE42) did not raise cross-group talk coupling (−0.02 [−0.13, 0.09], power 0.95 at J 0.3), and within-room read-gated coupling also fell in the merged week (0.08 vs 0.47 after the split): a read path is necessary but not sufficient, because merging dilutes per-pair coupling
